A student uses this method to investigate the reaction of dilute hydrochloric acid with zinc. pour some dilute hydrochloric acid into a glass beaker record the initial temperature of the acid add a piece of zinc and stir the mixture record the temperature of the mixture after one minute
This question is about some of the halogens and their compounds.
(a) Carbon dioxide changes directly from a solid to a gas without becoming a liquid. (i) Give the name of the change of state from solid to gas. (ii) Describe the test for carbon dioxide gas.

A student uses this apparatus to investigate the heat energy released when a liquid fuel is burned. This is the student's method. measure the mass of the spirit burner and fuel add 100 $ cm^{3} $ of water to the copper can record the temperature of the water use the spirit burner to heat the water until the temperature rises by $ 3 0^{\circ} \mathrm{C} $ immediately measure the new mass of the spirit burner and fuel

Nitric acid $ \left( \mathrm{H N O}_{3} \right) $ is used in the production of fertilisers. Nitric acid is manufactured in three stages. Stage1 ammonia reacts with oxygen in the presence of a platinum catalyst to produce nitrogen monoxide gas, NO, and water. Stage 2 nitrogen monoxide gas reacts with more oxygen to produce nitrogen dioxide gas, $ \mathrm{N O_{2}}. $ Stage 3 nitrogen dioxide gas reacts with water to produce nitric acid and more nitrogen monoxide gas.
